item: Persisted rollup refresh retires the in-memory store it replaces
summary: Open-on-main row 25: when the persisted store became available while an in-memory rollup was serving, _refresh_persisted_build wrote its connection over _STATE[con] without closing the in-memory one (up to DuckDB's whole memory limit held until exit) and left that store's offload folder on disk. It is now closed and its folder removed, under the serve lock, only after the persisted store is recorded.
